# Function isApp

  * isApp(obj: unknown): obj is [App](../classes/App.html)

Type guard to check if an object is an instance of App.

#### Parameters

The object to check.

#### Returns obj is [App](../classes/App.html)

True if the object is an instance of App, false otherwise.
